Hi Marissa / Karthik,

We're lining up a short Q3 pilot for inference over a HIPAA-scoped dataset. We need a recommendation for an isolated hosting model (Dedicated vs Private) and a concrete GPU sizing recommendation tied to a ~3 month pilot commitment. High level expectations: ~180 TPS peak across bot endpoints (burst to 300 TPS for short windows), average request ~700 tokens in / 120 tokens out, expected concurrency ~60 active sessions, and end-to-end 99th percentile latency target <= 450ms for the critical endpoint.

Constraints:
- Must be in an isolated environment (no multi-tenant GPU sharing).
- SOC2 evidence and KMS integration required.
- Procurement timeline: target signature by 2027-05-15 to start provisioning mid-June.
- Budget: trying to keep committed monthly spend under $180k where possible for pilot.

Can you provide: 1) a short recommendation (Dedicated vs Private) for the pilot and why, 2) a sizing matrix (GPU counts, expected throughput, headroom assumptions) and 3) a list of procurement artifacts you need so we can prepare?

Thanks,
Alan

Alan — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front: for a time-boxed pilot where you need isolation and a fast path to production, we recommend Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) for provisioning speed and predictable economics; Private (VPC/on-prem) is viable if you need full control of the control plane or an air-gapped environment, but it adds 4–8 weeks of ops lead time for installation and procurement.

I've attached an initial workbook (q3-pilot-initial-sizing.xlsx) with two sizing options:
- Option A: small Dedicated cluster (H100 80GB equivalents) sized for your 180 TPS steady, 300 TPS burst with ~1.5x headroom at 99p.
- Option B: slightly larger Dedicated cluster with a hot-warm split (some A100/80GB quantized instances for cost savings) that reduces monthly commit by ~18% but increases tail latency risk on cold KVs.

Immediate procurement items we need: signed MSA + SOW (we can send a DocuSign link), estimated monthly commit (used to size the reserved pool), SOC2 snapshot, contact for your security questionnaire, and KMS key policy for test integration. I cc'd Karthik and Soojin for the technical sizing and SOC2 packaging.

If you want, Karthik can send a compact tiling matrix with GPU counts and the assumed batch/quantization parameters we used.

Cheers,

Alan / Marissa — adding the technical sizing breakdown we used to populate Marissa's workbook. TL;DR: Recommended pilot = Dedicated with H100-class nodes, 6-node pool (logic below) with autoscale headroom; Private is recommended only if you require air-gapped control plane or on-prem hardware transfer.

Sizing assumptions (from your note + conservative headroom):
- Peak sustained TPS (token-level): 300 TPS peak for 30m bursts; steady 180 TPS.
- Avg IO: 700 in / 120 out tokens per request.
- Target latency: 99p <= 450ms. Allow 1.5x KV cache / prefix headroom for complex chains.
- Model: Llama-3-class 70B (fp16/4-bit quant options), KV scaling sensitive.

Node-level calculus (H100 80GB logical):
- Effective concurrent sessions per H100-equivalent: ~12-14 for 700/120 workload with quantized weights (q4_0) and batching at 64ms slice windows.
- Batch efficiency at target: ~1.8 tokens/ms with our optimized kernels; throughput per GPU ~50–60 tokens/ms sustained depending on seq length distribution.

Recommendation (pilot Dedicated):
- Option 1 (conservative): 6 x H100-equivalent GPUs (single tenant, reserved). Expected steady throughput ~200–230 TPS with autoscale burst buffer to 300 TPS for short windows. This gives ~1.5x headroom at 99p assuming prefix caching and continuous batching.
- Option 2 (cost-lean): 5 x H100 + 3 x A100-40GB quantized variants (hot-warm). Expected steady ~190 TPS, bursts to ~275 TPS; cost ~18% lower but requires warm-cache prewarmed policies.

Estimated monthly committed cost (ballpark for procurement):
- Option 1: ~$145k/month committed (reserved nodes + management).
- Option 2: ~$120k/month committed (savings from quantized warm nodes) but higher operational risk for 99p tail.

Operational notes & procurement artifacts:
- Lead time for Dedicated provisioning (6 nodes): ~2–3 weeks from signed SOW for hosted capacity in our US region; Private deployment (on-prem) ~6–8 weeks with site readiness checklist.
- SOC2: we can provide a redacted snapshot (attached SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf) and a package for your security questionnaire.
- KMS: we support bring-your-own KMS for dedicated capacity; need an IAM contact and key policy.
- Contract: We'll include an autoscale burst policy and a failover to compatible model variant (smaller mem-footprint) in the SOW.

Attached: h100-tiling-matrix.csv (detailed node CPU/GPU/NUMA headroom and expected token throughput). Happy to hop on a short call to walk the matrix.

-Karthik
